gaps: The report has no washing-machine-specific passive-component dataset; this is the generic GLO mix, so the BAFU dataset's composition may differ.
The dataset is a pure assembly of component datasets: no energy, no transport, no infrastructure and no direct emissions of its own.
The eight shares sum to 1.0003 kg per kg, i.e. the table is normalised to 1 kg of components.
Uncertainty is explicitly 'rather high' (StDv95 = 2.29 on every line).
